name: Relic Open Graph social card by Relic
description: A 1200×630 social card split into a quiet typographic left column and a tactile paper collage on the right. The top-left locks up an amber rounded-triangle mark with the wordmark and a black OPEN SOURCE pill; the headline sets two lines in a heavy geometric sans before pivoting to a high-contrast italic serif for the final phrase in amber — the card's strongest colour moment. The right half layers stationery ephemera (handwritten list, napkin, receipt, business card, polaroid) with soft directional shadows, topped by a translucent amber version of the logo object acting as the brand anchor, while a small letterspaced amber domain line closes the bottom-left.
